display_title: I Am Really the Only Tycoon
description:
Lee Kyung-Suk, a mother who spent her entire life sacrificing herself for her family. She was the very embodiment of devotion, yet her son, Seo Min-Uk, never once said “thank you.” Living in regret after his mother’s passing, Min-Uk is transported back to the day the family tragedy began—as his maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho—through an unbelievable miracle. His maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho. He left after trampling on the family’s dreams and hopes, devouring the family’s entire fortune and bringing everything crashing down. Back in the past, Min-Uk resolves to set things right, but he is confronted by doubts that grow deeper by the day. 

*“If only our family could escape this rain falling upon the world, would that truly be enough to satisfy us?”*

Will his choice to save the past truly make his mother happy? A tale of sacrifice, regret, and redemption begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)
